# dsh-control-surfbird-for-kitesurf

> DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin that lets an AI agent control a Kitesurf browser engine over CDP — 28 `surfbird_*` tools, one isolated browser per agent session. Works with the self-hosted surfbird distribution (raw/auth) and upstream Kitesurf.

## Key facts

- Package: `dsh-control-surfbird-for-kitesurf` on npm (Apache-2.0, Node >= 22.18, ESM)
- Tool prefix: `surfbird_*` (26 typed tools + status/capabilities reporting)
- Install: `dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-control-surfbird-for-kitesurf`
- Requires a Kitesurf-compatible CDP endpoint (surfbird container `auth` mode recommended, or upstream Kitesurf)
- Engine limits: no JS dialogs, file upload/download, clipboard, drag/touch, complete keyboard events
- `src/cdp/` is host-independent shared core (zero `@deepseek-ai/*` imports) — designed to be copied into OpenCode/Pi plugins
